description: Ask Amazon whether up to 25 products could be listed now — the same check as the Amazon channel page: the offline requirements (product type on the category, brand, a photo, the condition, a title of at most 75 characters), the price in the marketplace's currency, then Amazon's own dry run (VALIDATION_PREVIEW), which creates nothing. A product whose barcode Amazon already knows is checked as an OFFER on that existing item (ready rows carry its asin): only the condition and the price matter then, and a brand or category Amazon gates is refused with reason amazonListingRestricted and the approval links. Returns ready, blocked (reason, details, Amazon's sentence) and notAttemptedIds (call again with those). A blocked product's details also name what the Amazon product type still needs, found against Amazon's own schema before its dry run: missingFieldKeys (attribute keys), missingFields (their titles in the marketplace's language) and invalidFields. The CRM fills model_name (the model's code), list_price (the old price when higher, else the price, VAT included) and the item's dimensions itself; set anything else for Amazon with set_amazon_field_values (keys, kinds and allowed values from get_amazon_fields) — on the category or the model when every product shares the value. A characteristic named exactly like the field's title (upsert_product_attributes) also reaches Amazon, but characteristics are shown on the shop's site and every other channel, so keep them for real product facts. Needs a listing marketplace chosen on the Amazon connection; no arming. Then publish with publish_amazon_listings.
